findings.summary: SoundPlayer prepares files about 300 ms after init on the main actor; cues in that window are dropped.
currentLoop can stay set after a system audio interruption, so a loop may not restart until the list goes idle.
Hiss and door-and-hit start together on a row tap and on Go to Map; confirm by ear.
ThemedButtonStyle plays hiss on press; plain buttons play it on release.
AppPalette.onAppIconBackground and ThemeTests change (9b16611) is outside the sound feature; owner-approved.
Not verified: audible playback, fades, loop seams, VoiceOver on a device, macOS and visionOS audio, silent switch, mixing.
